title: UMCD ChannelDataset frozen split child artifact roster
description: The exact roster bytes must be detached-signature verified under the umcd-channel-child-artifact-roster-v1@github.com OpenSSH namespace. Each artifact must be a saved ChannelDataset NPZ whose rows declare the roster child_id, child_kind, and frozen parent_subject_id. This establishes semantic row-to-child coverage only for the signed roster and does not establish complete-corpus authority or release qualification.
